notes.title: coming soon: 0.5 tokyo game show update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468384/4af613dfc0c83003ca314c01618929dc042c9121.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you may know, PROJEKT GODHAND and its sister game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824730/Chronal_Chain/"]Chronal Chain[/url] (it has a Steam page now! check it out if you like danmaku and/or fluffy girls and/or being a badass time magician) will appear at Tokyo Game Show this year! We're hard at work on our new game demos, but here's a quick rundown of what you can expect in version 0.5, which will release on 9/25 (after the first business day of TGS):[/p][p][/p][p]Two new songs in CORE APPEND:[/p][p]These are part of a still-unannounced collaboration! We'll reveal them on the first day of TGS, so look forward to it. As usual, that's even more free additional playable content.[/p][p][/p][p]Big UI update:[/p][p]We've refreshed the game's interface with new graphics! Part of this update is a shiny new flame background, which is substantially dimmer during gameplay--we've heard some players mention that the background makes visibility difficult for them, so hopefully this takes care of it. There's a lot of other changes, and you can look forward to an overall sleeker and more visually consistent style.[/p][p][/p][p]Sort options:[/p][p]The songwheel is currently using what we call "vibes-based sorting", but if you'd rather sort things alphabetically or by (current) difficulty, we're cooking up something for you[/p][p][/p][p]Japanese language support:[/p][p]It's basically what you'd expect. A lot of the new UI elements are bilingual, in keeping with the game's cyberpunk setting and visual style, and the language setting takes care of the rest.[/p][p][/p][p]Return of the demo:[/p][p]If you've got friends who missed out on the prior demos and are on the fence about the game, let them know that it'll be possible to play a chunk of the game for free again soon! The new demo will be based on 0.5 and features 7 songs. To prevent future save-related issues (you might recall some issues happening with demo 1's save in the initial Early Access release, or save corruption related to playing NOISZ's demo after the full game), please note that this demo will save separately from the full game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]As previously announced, 0.5 is the final major update to the Early Access version (of course, we'll still make any needed bugfixes, etc). Afterwards, we'll be focusing on the new content for the full 1.0 release! Despite everything, PROJEKT GODHAND has yet to truly begin, after all...[/p]

notes.title: 0.4 NOISZ CONNECT update now available!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468384/c6bb2e5a8212a69ac7ef41f27ac143adc76aebed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update comes with a new pack, "NOISZ CONNECT"! If you have NOISZ on Steam, you'll find that you'll already have this pack for free, so don't buy it separately! (It's available as a separate purchase for players who aren't about that bullet hell life... but try out the demo just to be sure?)[/p][p][/p][p]We've also added some new enemies to punch for a little extra variety![/p][p][/p][p]There's a bit fewer front-facing changes in this build, but we're currently working on some new QoL updates such as song sorting options, as well as a substantial UI overhaul for 0.5, which will launch at Tokyo Game Show in late September (along with new CORE APPEND content featuring another new collaboration)![/p]

notes.title: 0.33 UNBEATABLE collab update now available!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468384/2c370a8825b1198754dd80a93ebeadd60fbbc541.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Yeah, we're newly announcing it, but you can play this update right now! Two new songs arrive from D-CELL GAMES' UNBEATABLE in CORE APPEND: FAMILIAR and (newly playable in both games) Proper Rhythm (MEMODEMO 271 BPM swag bootleg)!![/p][p][/p][p]We've made a couple of small UI updates to accomodate all the new crossover songs. You'll be able to see their origins directly on the songwheel now, alongside a handful of other fixes.[/p][p]
The game's 20% off right now, too, so tell your friends to demolish their keyboards too![/p][p][/p][p]And of course... Don't forget to wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2240620/UNBEATABLE/"]UNBEATABLE[/url] and check out its incredibly stylish demo![/p]

notes.title: 0.32 Rotaeno collab update now available!
notes.content:
As announced previously, this update adds two new songs to the CORE APPEND folder, from the mobile rhythm game Rotaeno! As with other CORE APPEND songs, this is additional free content.

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GxjpKeOWEAAOUqC?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]

You might see something rather new, so watch out...!

notes.title: new collabs coming! & 1.0 announcement
notes.content: [p]First off: we're excited to announce our upcoming collab with Dream Engine Games' mobile rhythm game, Rotaeno! For those unfamiliar with Rotaeno, it's a unique game where you rotate your phone (or tablet, if you want to get a strange workout) to hit the notes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GxjpKeOWEAAOUqC?format=jpg&name=medium"][/img][/p][p]Innocence Keeper and GALACTIC WARZONE will arrive as part of the CORE APPEND folder in just 2 days! As with other CORE APPEND stuff, this is free content. We've added some new spicy tech, so look forward to it![/p][p][/p][p]We also have another collaboration coming in 2 weeks which will also be a free CORE APPEND update, but it's secret for now...[/p][p][/p][p]An additional DLC pack "NOISZ Connect" will also be available at the end of the month for NOISZ's 7th anniversary! For anyone who owns NOISZ on Steam, this content is also free! We'll be making the pack available as a separate purchase if you're not about the rhythm bullet hell life (but we recommend trying out the demo just to be sure...)[/p][p][/p][p]Please do NOT purchase the pack if you already have NOISZ! It won't be added to future bundles for this reason.[/p][p][/p][p]If it looks to you like there's a surprising focus on additional content for Early Access, including DLC packs: you're right, these packs and CORE APPEND were originally intended to be released after GODHAND 1.0! But feedback about the gameplay has been extremely positive immediately on EA launch, and the most common request we've gotten is for more stuff to play, so we used the extra time that we'd set aside for potential gameplay revamps to accelerate the content schedule and give people what they want.[/p][p][/p][p]Our original release plan was for GODHAND 1.0 to have 35 songs of base content at launch, but we're currently projecting 46 songs of base content, plus 10 more in DLC packs. CORE APPEND will also continue to expand even further after the full version launch![/p][p][/p][p]Of course, we're still working on the backend, so you can expect to see additional features like sort options in the near future, too.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of 1.0, we're pleased to announce that the full release of the game is slated for January 2026! This comes with 10 more songs as base content which are associated with the first act of the story, "PROJEKT GODHAND paradiso".[/p][p][/p][p]This is the true beginning of PROJEKT GODHAND, whatever that means...?? Well, you'll find out soon enough...[/p]

notes.title: GODHAND 0.3 + new GALACTIC EXPEDITION pack!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468384/24aa9e5e9f9422a63efe9f31567d122f2606a6a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As previously announced, PROJEKT GODHAND 0.3 comes with the release of our first DLC pack GALACTIC EXPEDITION, which features an all-star cast of featured artists, charts that will test the limits of your skill, and the brand new CoURSE CHALLENGE mode![/p][p][/p][p]Also, GALACTIC EXPEDITION is 20% off as a launch discount, so pick it up early if you can![/p][p][/p][p]The base content of the game expands further with two new CORE APPEND songs, including our first collaboration, grode (Wyvren's Remix) from vivid/stasis, and the winner of our HIT EM contest, May![/p][p][/p][p]We've also reshuffled the game's difficulty rating system after observing the play data and resulting automatic ratings--the 8000 to 9000s range has been expanded to 8000 to 10000s, forming an additional difficulty block! This should provide a more accurate picture of difficulty and help players moving up the ranks with picking out appropriate challenges.[/p][p][/p][p]Next month, content will focus on even more collab songs! We'll also do a bit of work on UI and try to improve visual accessibility for players who need it. Keep an eye out for exciting new announcements![/p]

notes.title: 0.3 and onward roadmap
notes.content: [p]You might have seen a new addition to the Steam page... in next month's version 0.3, we're introducing the game's first DLC pack, Galactic Expedition![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468384/3f05d01b549568ccb46099fca59cfa2ef2fb3216.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A special new mode will also be available in DLC pack folders, introducing a bit of a twist to the established gameplay. It's a fun new way to experience these songs... or a horrific and sweaty challenge? It's up to you!! Find out more soon...[/p][p][/p][p]Avid rhythm gamers will probably note from the artist list that we're committed to making the DLC for this game top shelf stuff--we want everyone to feel that both the base game and additional packs are easily worth their price tags! And on that note, we're continuing to reinforce the value of the base game by adding two more Core Append songs in this update, including our first collaboration with another rhythm game. What could it be...?[/p][p][/p][p]0.3 will also expand the rating system somewhat--you've probably seen some charts pushing the edges of their difficulty block, but there are several cases where they'd be at the other edge of the next difficulty block if they were moved! In order to accomodate these, we're splitting the 8000s and 9000s blocks into three blocks (8000s-10000s), with the higher blocks largely being pushed up by 1000. With our system, it's actually possible to make this change without even pushing an update, but the new content release is a good time to try it out. We'll continue to monitor the game's rating scale in pursuit of the most scientific ratings in any rhythm game![/p][p][/p][p]Following 0.3, we'll be focusing on readying the game's Japanese language option ahead of Tokyo Game Show, as well as some additional content we'll unveil at the event, so the next major update is expected to launch in late September! [/p]

notes.title: 0.21 "the cheaper prices update" now available!
notes.content:
We've heard feedback that the chart unlock prices in Core Append are too high--we've been keeping an eye on everyone's Kelvin totals and we agree! Balancing stuff is part of what Early Access is about, so bear with us.

You can now get a big discount on a song's charts by increasing its song level! You'll need to pick up at least one of its charts to do this. You can opt to pick up the Kindled chart (it's always the cheapest) to soften up the other unlock prices, or maybe you want to grind out the Maximum right away and then pick up the lower difficulties once they've become much cheaper? It's up to you!

We'll be keeping an eye on feedback and play data as we go for future development, of course. For now, we hope this will help you enjoy the new content introduced in 0.20 more!

notes.title: 0.2 "the CORE APPEND update" now available!
notes.content:
The first major PROJEKT GODHAND Early Access update is now available! That's right, sometimes "early June" is June 1st (maybe 2nd, depending on your timezone).

As you may have seen, this adds 3 new songs to the "GODHAND Core Append" folder (and also adds folder selection to music select so that you can. select the new folder)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468384/772aebb3199f0014fcde97a8fbe7c5e79d9746b5.jpg[/img]

We're all excited for new playable content, but there's more! You can now level up individual songs by playing them (get a bonus for playing each of its charts for the first time), and increase your own player level by playing anything (this gets faster based on all of your song levels). What are the levels for? Find out later!

You'll also gain Kelvins by playing anything, which you can spend to unlock songs in Core Append (there'll be way more of these to come in the future!) Boost the Heat Gauge as much as you can to gain Kelvins faster.

Check it out, and keep an eye out for more additions as development continues!

notes.title: 0.2 update coming soon!
notes.content:
As mentioned in the last update, GODHAND 0.2's biggest new feature is an expanding free song folder, "GODHAND Core Append". We're pleased to announce the initial songlist for Core Append, as well as that 0.2 will drop in early June!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468384/772aebb3199f0014fcde97a8fbe7c5e79d9746b5.jpg[/img]

As the "new folder" bit implies, we'll also be adding song folder functionality to this update, with the game's default songlist (the stuff you've seen in 0.1) being in the "GODHAND Core" folder.

Core Append charts will be unlocked with a new item: Kelvins can be obtained by clearing any songs, and accumulate more rapidly with higher scores, so be sure to boost that Heat Gauge! You'll obtain Kelvins retroactively for plays recorded in 0.1, so don't worry about missing out.

We're also planning another new feature for 0.2, but it'll be secret for just a little longer...

notes.title: Early Access first steps
notes.content:
First off: a massive thank you to everyone who's picked up GODHAND in Early Access, and a second thank you to everyone who's already reviewed it! We've already hit Very Positive, and the reception has blown all our expectations out of the water. But of course, this is just the beginning, since Early Access means we've all got a journey ahead until the game's 1.0 release. What's coming next?

The #1 thing we're hearing people want is more GODHAND. Reviews and comments often note that the songlist right now isn't as large as they'd like. All said: that's great! We're glad you're enjoying the game enough to want more, especially because there's more coming.

Next month, we'll be bringing new base content in the form of GODHAND Core Append. The current list of 25 songs will be known as "GODHAND Core", while Core Append will be a gradually expanding folder of new content at no additional cost. Look forward to 3 new songs in its initial launch, and further additions both as we head toward the 1.0 release and afterward!

As you might be aware, the first part of the game's story, ACT 1 "paradiso" will also be base content, so that's another 10 songs coming to you in the game's 1.0 release.

If that's still not enough, we've got some further announcements down the line, but let's be patient for now...

In other news, we're aware of some minor issues that we'll also be fixing probably within the next week, and you'll be seeing some improvements to the game's automatic difficulty rating system in the next few updates.

...Basically, if you like what you're seeing now, let's all look forward to the future! In the meantime, be sure to tell your friends how much fun you're having demolishing your keyboards!!
